descriptionByLocale.it:
I tuoi compiti
• Sosterrete la creazione e lo sviluppo di una piattaforma nazionale di dati sepsis come base per il miglioramento della qualità, il benchmarking e la ricerca.
• Coordinate la raccolta, l'armonizzazione e la garanzia di qualità dei dati provenienti da istituzioni partner, lavorando a stretto contatto con esperti clinici, responsabili del trattamento dei dati, team ICT, e organizzazioni nazionali e stakeholder nei settori della cura, della garanzia di qualità, della ricerca e della salute pubblica.
• Contribuirai all'ulteriore sviluppo di concetti e processi per la valutazione del programma svizzero Sepsis e sostenere la loro attuazione.
• Contribuirai allo sviluppo di una strategia di valutazione sostenibile per misure di miglioramento della qualità nel settore della sepsi.
• L'utente supporta la definizione e l'ulteriore sviluppo di standard di documentazione, specifiche di dati e flussi di dati per il registro nazionale.
• L'analisi di indicatori economici di processo, risultato e salute sono anche parte dei vostri compiti e li preparate per diversi stakeholder.
• Crea valutazioni, report, dashboard e analisi di benchmarking regolari per valutare l’impatto del programma.
• Sostieni la gestione dei programmi medici e operativi nel monitoraggio, reporting e valutazioni scientifiche. Il tuo profilo
• Laurea (master o equivalente) in sanità pubblica, epidemiologia, scienze della salute, economia sanitaria, informatica medica, scienza dei dati, biostatistica o un campo correlato
• Esperienza professionale nell'analisi, interpretazione e preparazione dei dati sanitari, idealmente nel campo della gestione della qualità, epidemiologia, ricerca sanitaria o ricerca clinica
• Esperienza nel trattare con grandi set di dati, database e processi di qualità dei dati
• Buona conoscenza dei metodi statistici e dell'analisi dei dati e dell'esperienza con le soluzioni software corrispondenti (ad esempio R, Python, STATA o strumenti simili)
• L'esperienza con SQL, REDCap, Power BI o piattaforme di report e dati simili è un vantaggio
• Interessi in miglioramento della qualità nel settore sanitario, della ricerca sanitaria, dello sviluppo del registro e della scienza dell'implementazione
• Metodi di lavoro indipendenti, strutturati e orientati alla soluzione nonché forti competenze analitiche
• Alta capacità di comunicazione e di squadra, nonché il godimento della cooperazione interdisciplinare

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your tasks
• You will support the establishment and further development of a national sepsis data platform as a basis for quality improvement, benchmarking and research.
• You coordinate the collection, harmonization and quality assurance of data from partner institutions, working closely with clinical experts, data controllers, ICT teams, and national organizations and stakeholders in the areas of care, quality assurance, research and public health.
• You will contribute to the further development of concepts and processes for the evaluation of the Swiss Sepsis program and support their implementation.
• You will contribute to the development of a sustainable evaluation strategy for quality improvement measures in the area of sepsis.
• You support the definition and further development of documentation standards, data specifications and data flows for the national registry.
• The analysis of process, outcome and health economic indicators are also part of your tasks and you prepare them for different stakeholders.
• You create regular evaluations, reports, dashboards and benchmarking analyses to evaluate the program’s impact.
• You support medical and operational program management in monitoring, reporting and scientific evaluations. Your profile
• Graduate degree (master or equivalent) in public health, epidemiology, health sciences, health economics, medical computer science, data science, biostatistics or a related field
• Professional experience in the analysis, interpretation and preparation of health data, ideally in the field of quality management, epidemiology, healthcare research or clinical research
• Experience in dealing with large data sets, databases and data quality processes
• Good knowledge of statistical methods and data analysis as well as experience with corresponding software solutions (e.g. R, Python, STATA, or similar tools)
• Experience with SQL, REDCap, Power BI or similar data and reporting platforms is an advantage
• Interest in quality improvement in healthcare, healthcare research, registry development and implementation science
• Independent, structured and solution-oriented working methods as well as strong analytical skills
• High communication and team skills as well as enjoyment of interdisciplinary cooperation
• Very good knowledge of German and English in words and writing; Knowledge of French is an advantage Prof.Dr. med. titleByLocale.it:
Responsabile Mass Spectrometry (m/f) 100% - NCCR Children & Cancer

The Morscher Laboratory works at the intersection of pediatric oncology and fundamental Ricerca in metabolism. Stable isotope tracing is a core methodology of the lab - applied across cell culture, animal models, and directly in patients to map metabolic fluxes at quantitative resolution. We combine this with single-cell metabolomics, RNA mass spectrometry, and proteomics to decode metabolic programs from the whole organism down to the single cell - and to translate these insights into new treatment strategies for children with cancer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your responsibilities You will lead the day-to-day operations of the MS platform, including scheduling, quality control and sample throughput across metabolomics, isotope tracing and other MS-omics workflows. In this role, you drive method development for LC-MS/MS-based stable isotope tracing, metabolomics, RNA modifications and lipid analysis, including applications to in vivo and patient-derived samples. You ensure high data quality, robust data management and fully reproducible workflows through rigorous QC and precise documentation. You will co-develop and implement automated sample preparation workflows to increase throughput and improve reproducibility. Co-design of the data acquisition and processing infrastructure around Orbitrap Astral instruments will be part of your responsibilities. You maintain mass spectrometry instruments at the highest performance standards and manage service contracts as well as consumables. Contribution to the development of single-cell mass spectrometry methods is expected as part of the lab's technology development agenda. You actively contribute to research projects, from experimental planning and data interpretation through to manuscript writing. Training and mentoring of graduate students, postdocs, and collaborators in MS techniques and experimental design is an important part of your work. You advise on and support the procurement of future equipment and contribute to grant applications for infrastructure funding. You represent the platform in internal and external collaborations across the Zurich life sciences community.
• Your profile Expert (MSc or PhD) in analytical chemistry, biochemistry, or a closely related field - with a strong mass spectrometry track record; Experience matters. Hands-on expertise with high-resolution LC-MS platforms, ideally including Orbitrap-based instruments Proven experience in stable isotope tracing and/or metabolomics in a biological research context - this is central to the lab's work Demonstrated ability to develop and optimize analytical methods from first principles Experience with or strong interest in laboratory automation - liquid handling systems, automated sample prep, or workflow scripting Interest in or experience with single-cell mass spectrometry technologies is a plus Experience mentoring or teaching MS techniques to non-specialists Strong publication record showing independent scientific contributions Experience running or co-running a core or research facility is a strong plus, not prerequisite Fluent in English; German is an asset but not required Dr. Dr. med. univ. • You operate and maintain the mass spectrometry infrastructure, including Orbitrap Astral instruments and supporting LC systems, ensuring consistently high performance.
• Coordination, preparation, and processing of biological samples for stable isotope tracing, metabolomics, epitranscriptomics, and other MS-omics analyses - including low-input and single-cell samples - are part of your responsibilities.
• You support the implementation of automated sample preparation pipelines to increase throughput and improve reproducibility.
• Hands-on guidance and training of students and postdocs in the use of the instruments is an important part of your role.
• You actively contribute to the development and optimization of LC-MS methods for metabolite quantification, isotope enrichment, lipid profiling, and modified nucleotides.
• Routine instrument calibration, troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance are carried out by you independently.
• You support data acquisition as well as initial QC and processing pipelines.
• You perform MS data processing and analysis across applications and collaborative projects, ensuring high data quality and consistency.
• You manage MS data across projects to ensure traceability, organization, and reproducibility.
• You also help manage consumables, sample logistics, and platform documentation. Your profile
• Complete application package, including a motivation letter, CV, diplomas and employment certificates/references
• Expert (MSc or PhD) in analytical chemistry, biochemistry, or a related field
• Solid practical experience with LC-MS/MS - ideally on Orbitrap-based instruments
• Background in stable isotope tracing and/or metabolomics in a biological setting is strongly preferred
• Interest in or experience with laboratory automation - liquid handling, automated sample prep, or scripted workflows
• Curiosity about emerging technologies, particularly single-cell mass spectrometry, is a genuine plus
• Methodical, detail-oriented, and comfortable troubleshooting complex instrument issues
• Able to work independently and communicate clearly with researchers at all levels
• Experience in a core facility, CRO, or research lab environment is valued
• English required; German is a plus Dr. Dr. med. univ. (A) Raphael Morscher Research Group Leader +41 44 249 65 84 Kinderspital Zürich as an employer Kinderspital Zürich is the largest university children's hospital in Switzerland with about 2,500 employees, and is one of the leading centres for paediatric and youth medicine in Europe. Although the hospital may be big, it's the little ones that count: up to 100,000 patients are cared for each year across 47 faculties, where we do everything in our power to ensure their well being. 'Kispi' not only offers cutting-edge devices and the highest quality of care, but also a good sense of interpersonal issues. Alongside its comprehensive range of paediatric medicine and surgery facilities, the children's hospital also offers a unique rehabilitation centre and a research centre.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione del lavoro
• I tuoi compiti - Ti prendi cura di giovani con problematiche psicosomatiche e psichiatriche coinvolgendo attivamente le loro famiglie nella zona giorno. - Insieme ai giovani, ai loro genitori e al nostro team multiprofessionale, progetterai un'assistenza individuale. - Aderisci costantemente ai nostri elevati standard di qualità e contribuisci allo sviluppo continuo. - Puoi vivere il tuo lato creativo progettando varie attività di gruppo che portano gioia a tutti. - Come accompagnatore sostieni i nostri futuri studenti infermieristici HF/FH nel loro percorso. Il tuo profilo - Hai un diploma in infermieristica HF o FH o in pedagogia sociale che sottolinea le tue conoscenze specialistiche approfondite. - Hai molta familiarità con la tua esperienza nel trattare con i giovani e le loro famiglie in un ambiente di terapia ambientale. - Sei un giocatore di squadra in tutto e per tutto e risplendi attraverso il tuo modo di lavorare cooperativo. - Grazie alla tua flessibilità, mantieni sempre la visione d'insieme e mantieni la calma, anche in situazioni difficili. - La tua disponibilità ad assumerti responsabilità ti rende un prezioso supporto nel nostro team. Contatto Gabi Boegli Responsabile Servizio infermieristico +41 44 249 42 21 Informazioni sull'Azienda Ospedale pediatrico di Zurigo - Con circa 3.000 dipendenti, l'Ospedale pediatrico di Zurigo è il più grande ospedale pediatrico universitario della Svizzera e uno dei centri leader in Europa per la medicina infantile e adolescenziale. - Ma la cosa più bella di “Kispi” sono i più piccoli: ogni anno vengono curati fino a 100.000 pazienti e facciamo di tutto per il loro benessere in 47 reparti specializzati. - Al Kispi non sono importanti solo le attrezzature più moderne e la massima qualità dei trattamenti, ma anche un buon feeling per i rapporti interpersonali. - Oltre all'intero spettro medico e chirurgico pediatrico, l'ospedale pediatrico offre anche un centro di riabilitazione e un centro di ricerca unici.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description of the work
• Your tasks - You look after young people with psychosomatic and psychiatric challenges by actively involving their families in the living area. - Together with the young people, their parents and our multi-professional team, you will design individual care. - You consistently adhere to our high quality standards and contribute to continuous development. - You can live out your creative side by designing varied group activities that bring joy to everyone. - As an accompanying person, you support our prospective HF/FH nursing students on their path.
• Your profile - You have a diploma in nursing HF or FH or in social pedagogy that underlines your in-depth specialist knowledge. - You are very familiar with your experience in dealing with young people and their families in a milieu therapy environment. - You are a team player through and through and shine through your cooperative way of working. - Thanks to your flexibility, you always maintain an overview and keep a cool head, even in challenging situations. - Your willingness to take on responsibility makes you a valuable support in our team. Contatto Gabi Boegli Head of Nursing Service +41 44 249 42 21 Informazioni sull'Azienda The Zurich Children's Hospital - With around 3,000 employees, the Zurich Children's Hospital is the largest university children's hospital in Switzerland and one of the leading centers for child and adolescent medicine in Europe. - But the greatest thing about “Kispi” is the little ones: up to 100,000 patients are cared for every year, and we do everything for their well-being in 47 specialist departments. - Not only the most modern equipment and the highest quality of treatment are important at Kispi, but also a good feeling for interpersonal relationships. - In addition to the entire pediatric medical and pediatric surgical spectrum, the children's hospital also offers a unique rehabilitation center and a research center.
